Open Secret Special STORY #6482

THIS IS A STORY ABOUT THE BAD AND THE BRAVE…
AND HOW AN INVESTIGATOR ON A DARK JOURNEY EXPOSES SHOCKING SECRETS AT THE HEART OF THE SOUTH AFRICAN NATIONAL DEFENCE FORCE…

IT’S A STORY THAT STARTS ON THE CAPE COAST, AND TAKES HIM FROM SIMONSTOWN IN THE WESTERN CAPE TO PHALABORWA IN THE NORTH AND THEN TO A MILITARY BASE IN PRETORIA.

WHILE STILL UNRESOLVED, THE INVESTIGATION EXPOSES A GROUPING OF ELITE SOLDIERS AND SANDF OFFICIALS WHO APPEAR TO OPERATE ABOVE THE LAW, ENGAGING IN ILLEGAL CAMPAIGNS INVOLVING TORTURE, POLITICS, SPYCRAFT, AND EVEN MURDER.

AND THE FIRST CLUE CAME WITH THE ARRIVAL OF A MYSTERIOUS VESSEL AT THE SIMONSTOWN NAVAL BASE ON THE NIGHT OF THE 6TH OF DECEMBER 2022

THE INVESTIGATOR, HENNIE VAN VUUREN, IS AN ANTI-CORRUPTION ACTIVIST AND RESEARCHER ROLLED INTO ONE, WITH EXPERIENCE IN DOCUMENTING THE MOVEMENT OF WEAPONS.

Hennie van Vuuren
Director: Open Secrets
We work like investigative journalists. But we're slightly different. We investigate economic crime, where there's a link to human rights abuse, we investigate, we publish those findings.

SO THE LONG-LENS EVIDENCE OF CARGO BEING LOADED OFF AND POSSIBLY ON TO THIS VESSEL, A US-SANCTIONED RUSSIAN CARGO SHIP CALLED THE LADY R, WAS OF GREAT INTEREST TO HENNIE.
IT’S ARRIVAL HAD PUT LOCAL SHIPSPOTTERS ON HIGH ALERT,
IN THE ABSENCE OF OFFICIAL INFORMATION, PUBLIC SPECULATION AS TO WHY THE LADY R HAD DROPPED ANCHOR GREW TO FEVER PITCH.
IMAGES WERE CIRCULATED SHOWING VEHICLES STANDING BY.

Hennie van Vuuren
Director: Open Secrets
… we were able, through some sources, to obtain a copy of a photograph. … But this time, the number plates were clear. And with that number plates, we were then able to start searching where else might this vehicle have appeared.

AND BINGO - THREE WEEKS LATER, ONE OF THE SAME CARS WITH AN IDENTICAL NUMBER PLATE WAS CAPTURED BY CCTV CAMERAS IN ANOTHER PROVINCE.

Hennie van Vuuren
Director: Open Secrets
So it's extraordinary that we find the same vehicle, white Mercedes Benz , we were able to establish through photographs that we obtained … that it's registered against a front company, if you'd like a shell company, that front companies directors are all members of a Special Forces unit in Phaloborwa.

PETERS COMMUNICATION TRUST IS THE UNLIKELY NAME OF THIS COMPANY, WHICH IS REGISTERED TO THE SANDF’S SPECIAL FORCES, AN ELITE BRIGADE OF HIGHLY TRAINED COMBATANTS, COLLOQUIALLY KNOW AS THE RECCES.
IN WHAT SEEMED TO BE AN UNCANNY COINCIDENCE, ONE OF THEIR VEHICLES WAS DOCUMENTED IN GAUTENG.

Hennie van Vuuren
Director: Open Secrets
And what we then found out is that the same vehicle … was on the scene of the abduction of a suspected Islamic State member in the Mall of Africa, only three weeks later on the 29th of December.

HENNIE’S STORY NOW LURCHES IN AN UNEXPECTED DIRECTION – BUT BIZARRELY THIS UNEXPLAINED KIDNAPPING PROVIDES CLUES TO TRUTHS THAT UNTIL NOW HAVE BEEN LURKING IN THE SHADOWS.

GOVAN WHITTLES PIECE TO CAM:
This is one of the busiest malls in Gauteng, people come here from all over to do their shopping and in December 2022 an Ethiopian man and his bodyguard disappeared into thin air, one moment he was paying for his parking ticket - and the next moment he was gone.

PANICKING, THE FAMILY OF THE MISSING MAN, ABDELLA ABADIGA, GOT HOLD OF CCTV FOOTAGE AND TRACKED HIS MOVEMENTS, TO SEE WHO WAS ON HIS TAIL. AND HIRED A LAWYER, YUSUF CASSIM.

Yusuf Cassim
Lawyer for family of Abdella Abadiga
Lat time our client was seen, was at the pay station, and directly behind him few seconds later, was the actual member of Special Forces who paid for three tickets of their vehicles at the same time. We believe he was then followed to his vehicle, they were those vehicles waiting in the parking lot. And that's where he was abducted from.

THE SANDF ADMITTED THAT SPECIAL FORCES WERE AT THE MALL OF AFRICA ON THAT DAY UNDER THE COMMAND OF A MAJOR PINNY SUNNYBOOI WAMBI WHO PAID FOR THE PARKING TICKETS.
BUT THE SANDF DENIED KIDNAPPING ABDELLA ABADIGA AND HIS BODYGUARD.

Yusuf Cassim
Lawyer for family of Abdella Abadiga
They claim that they were there on a training exercise …. So you have a training exercise being conducted in a public space in a mall without anyone's knowledge. Now, that to us is totally unbelievable.

WE KNOW VERY LITTLE ABOUT THIS ETHIOPIAN BUSINESSMAN, SAVE THAT HE WAS LISTED ON A UNITED STATES SANCTIONS LIST AS A FINANCIER FOR THE ISLAMIC TERRORIST GROUP, ISIS.

YUSUF CASSIM MANAGED TO GET THE POLICE TO INVESTIGATE IN WHAT LOOKS TO HIM SUSPICIOUSLY LIKE A STATE SANCTIONED ABDUCTION,

Yusuf Cassim
Lawyer for family of Abdella Abadiga
This has the making of a rendition. I mean, this reminds one of apartheid style tactics, you know, where you simply kidnap an individual and that's it. That's the last time you hear or see of them.

BUT THE ABADIGA INVESTIGATION EXPERIENCED SETBACKS.
FIRST, WHEN THE ELITE INVESTIGATIVE UNIT, THE HAWKS, SOUGHT THE CELLPHONE RECORDS OF THE SPECIAL FORCES MEMBERS PHOTOGRAPHED IN THE MALL OF AFRICA, THEY MET WITH RESISTANCE IN COURT FROM THE SANDF.
AND THEN ON THE 6TH OF AUGUST THE INVESTIGATOR ON THE CASE, LIEUTENANT COLONEL FRANS MATHIPA, WAS ASSASINATED.

Hennie van Vuuren
Director: Open Secrets
He was driving along the highway, north of Pretoria close to Hammandskraal. He was booked out that night to investigate specifically the role of Special Forces in the abduction of these of these individuals in the Mall of Africa. And he was shot from what we understand twice in the heads with while driving his vehicle.…

IT WAS A SOPHISTICATED HIT - WHICH IN ITSELF WAS A CLUE AS TO WHO MAY HAVE PULLED THE TRIGGER

GOVAN WHITTLES PIECE TO CAM
Shooting someone from a moving vehicle is incredibly difficult.
Hitting them twice in the head means you are an elite level marksman.
That should tell you who we are dealing with.

Yusuf Cassim
Lawyer for family of Abdella Abadiga
We are dealing with dangerous individuals who can do anything, it seems as they please, you know, they they seem to be above the law.

BACK AT OPEN SECRETS, HENNIE SENSED THERE WAS WORSE TO COME.

Hennie van Vuuren
Director: Open Secrets
At that stage we started to identify a pattern of abuse and criminality. We believe according to eyewitnesses and sources, that involves senior generals, it’s a pattern of abuse and human rights violations, of torture, and murder that involves members of Special Forces.

IT WAS LIKE A RUSSIAN DOLL.
IN THE LADY R COVER-UP THERE WAS A LINK TO A MYSTERIOUS ABDUCTION….
THEN CAME THE ASSASSINATION OF THE HAWKS INVESTIGATOR AND THE NEXT REVELATION TOOK HENNIE BACK IN TIME – TO A MILITARY BASE IN LYTTELTON, PRETORIA FROM WHERE ON THE 23RD OF DECEMBER 2019, 18 R4 ASSAULT RIFLES HAD BEEN STOLEN.

THIS THEFT EMBARRASSED THE SANDF PUBLICALLY.
AND BEHIND THE SCENES, ACCORDING TO HENNIE’S SOURCES, THE MILITARY’S SPECIAL FORCES GOT TO WORK TO RETRIEVE THE STOLEN WEAPONS AND BRING THE CULPRITS IN.

Hennie van Vuuren
Director: Open Secrets
When we were looking at the role of special forces…. we had various whistle-blowers who approached Open Secrets. And those whistle-blowers there are a number of them, many of them work within the state, some of them have been in state security forces previously. But they had different stories to tell and those stories came together to support this, what we've now come to is an understanding of the operation of a torture squad within the South African National Defence Force.

AS THE STORY OF THE WEAPONS HUNT UNFOLDS, HENNIE IS GIVEN AN EYE-WITNESS ACCOUNT OF ANOTHER ALLEGED ABDUCTION, INVOLVING THE SAME SPECIAL FORCES OPERATIVE MAJOR PINNY SUNNYBOOI WAMBI, AROUND SIX WEEKS AFTER THE THEFT OF THE RIFLES.

Hennie van Vuuren
Director: Open Secrets
They have Defence Force Intelligence officials, who according to our sources are guiding them to find someone's cell phone. So again, there is illegal surveillance that's taking place, you have this convoy of vehicles that's making its way along parts of the East Rand.

ACCORDING TO A WHISTLEBLOWER, THEY ABDUCT A MAN KNOWN ONLY AS SPHAMANDLA FROM A FAST FOOD RESTAURANT IN KEMPTON PARK. THERE THEY ALLEGEDLY FORCE HIM INTO THEIR VEHICLES.

GOVAN WHITTLES PIECE TO CAM It’s hard to imagine the military rolling in here to abduct someone. This is a family friendly space – it’s meant to be a safe zone in the Kempton Park CBD.

IT’S ALLEGED THAT THE SPECIAL FORCES TAKE SPHAMANDLA BACK TO THE MILITARY POLICE BAR WHERE THEY TORTURE HIM TO DEATH THAT SAME NIGHT.


GOVAN WHITTLES: … all of this is an illegal operation?

Hennie van Vuuren
Director: Open Secrets
Every element of this is criminal. There's nothing here. There's nothing here that's normal. Everything is abnormal. It's anti constitutional.

HENNIE WAS THEN APPROACHED BY A FORMER SECURITY OPERATIVE WHO HAD A FEW WEEKS LATER, BEEN LURED TO PRETORIA UNDER THE PRETEXT OF IDENTIFYING A CULPRIT, IN THIS SAME THEFT OF MILITARY WEAPONS.

NOW IN HIDING, PULE NKOMO WAS PREPARED TO TALK TO US TOO.
HE SAID WE COULD USE HIS NAME, BUT NOT SHOW HIS FACE FOR FEAR OF BEING FOUND. HE ALLEGES HE WAS SUMMONED BY AN SANDF OFFICER WHO IS NOW THE CHIEF OF THE ARMY, GENERAL LAWRENCE MBATHA HIMSELF.

Pule Nkomo
Victim of Torture
General Mbatha called me and said you, Pule, here. We need you to assistance in profiling a person is a former operative also in the security structure. They need to identify him…and they said that he was involved in the Military base robbery. I was a bit scared. I was a bit scared.

When Pule arrived in Pretoria, he parked his car across the road and told them he had arrived by bus at the Bosman Station. They told him to wait at that hotel. They told him a little later to go to a nearby shop and walk around for twenty minutes, he thinks that is when they were scoping him out to see if he came alone. Then finally they made contact.

FROM THE VICTORIA HOTEL, PULE SAYS HE WAS DRIVEN IN A CONVOY OF CARS TO THE MILITARY BASE THABA TSHWANE
THEN TAKEN TO AN OFFICE BY A FEMALE MAJOR.

Pule Nkomo
Victim of Torture
She left me there and said I must sit there, they took my phone, my tablet and the bags, left with them.

PULE CLAIMS MBATHA AND OTHER SENIOR MILITARY OFFICIALS THEN ASKED HIM TO MAKE A FALSE STATEMENT TO THE POLICE.
THEY WANTED HIM TO IMPLICATE A SENIOR POLITICIAN, WHOSE NAME WE KNOW, IN THE RIFLE ROBBERY, A SERIOUS CRIME.

AND ALARMED, PULE DECLINED THE DIRTY TRICKS MISSION AND ASKED TO GO HOME.

GOVAN WHITTLES: Did they say anything after you said no?

PULE NKOMO: They, they said no, Major call your guys so that they can squeeze his balls…. they came in, after the Major went to call them and started hitting me, in the presence of the General, Colonel, Brigadier, everyone was there.

GOVAN WHITTLES: So you passed out?

PULE NKOMO: I passed out. When I wake up, I was in hospital.

GOVAN WHITTLES: Which hospital?

PULE NKOMO: Kalafong.

AS HIS MEDICAL RECORDS TESTIFY, PULE AWOKE DIZZY AND BATTERED.
BUT HE ALLEGES THEY WERE NOT FINISHED WITH HIM:
CLAIMING THAT HE WAS A HIGH-LEVEL SUSPECT, THEY TOOK HIM BACK TO THABA TSHWANE, AND TRIED AGAIN TO CO-ERCE HIM TO TAKE THE JOB.

PULE NKOMO: I still went and said no. Then that’s when the intense torture happened. The biggest torture, being beaten, being kicked.

GOVAN WHITTLES: Just try to describe it for me.
PULE NKOMO:. I was tubed –

GOVAN WHITTLES: What’s that?

PULE NKOMO: Like they pour too much water on you so that they can - like you drown. They stopped, give you a few minutes, a minute or less, they put a big tube over your face, beat you on top of that tube, kick you everything and came a time when I said to them okay I'll need time to, to think.

GOVAN WHITTLES: Who was doing this to you?

PULE NKOMO: The guys in balaclavas

PULE TOLD US THE MEN IN BALACLAVAS HELD HIM FOR FIVE DAYS.
ON THE LAST DAY, AN OFFICIAL FROM A DIFFERENT SECURITY AGENCY ARRIVED AT THE BASE AND FACILITATED HIS RELEASE, GIVING THE BROKEN MAN A BUS TICKET AND SOME CASH FOR THE ROAD HOME.

GOVAN WHITTLES PIECE TO CAMERA:
The SANDF is notoriously tight-lipped about its secrets, but in this instance keeping allegations of criminality under wraps is proving difficult for its Top Brass. That’s partly because victims and witnesses are coming forward to seek justice.

AFTER A BUILD UP OF COMPLAINTS, THE SANDF SET UP A BOARD OF INQUIRY WHICH HAS TAKEN EVIDENCE ON ALLEGATIONS OF SANDF CRIMES THAT TOOK PLACE BETWEEN 2017 AND 2022 – CORRUPTION, COLLUSION, ASSAULT AND TORTURE.
BUT THE CHIEF OF THE SANDF HAS FAILED TO ACT ON THIS REPORT.
ACCORDING TO SOURCES IT MAY MAKE ADVERSE FINDINGS AGAINST THE CHIEF OF THE MILITARY POLICE REAR ADMIRAL MAKGODI MAPHOTO.


SO IN NOVEMBER, THE SANDF’S MOST SENIOR MILITARY POLICEMAN, CHIEF WARRANT OFFICER RAPHAEL NDAWO, SIDE STEPPED HIS OWN EMPLOYER AND REACHED OUT TO THE HEAD OF AFRIFORUM’S PRIVATE PROSECUTION UNIT, GERRIE NEL.

Gerrie Nel
Afriforum Private Prosecutor
he exhausted all internal processes. And he then said, that's, that's enough. You know, he's a brave man. He's got no tolerance for corruption. And he said, something must happen. And I agree with him.

NEL HAS WRITTEN A LETTER URGING THE CHIEF OF THE DEFENCE FORCE TO ACT ON THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE INQUIRY. IT IS UNDERSTOOD THAT THERE ARE AT LEAST TWENTY BOXES OF EVIDENCE.

Gerrie Nel
Afriforum Private Prosecutor
They were looking at corruption, corruption with the PPE purchases…procurement fraud, the fact that certain investigations were not proceeded with because people were sheltered from prosecution, and then disturbingly, also that people were tortured, and that people lost their lives during investigation. So that was disturbing.

HENNIE HAS HIS OWN GROWING DOSSIER DETAILING ALLEGATIONS OF SANDF CRIMINALITY.
PULE CAN IDENTIFY INDIVIDUALS WHO HE ALLEGES WERE PRESENT DURING HIS TORTURE ORDEAL.
MAJOR DORRIS NTSHENZHWE, REAR ADMIRAL MAPHOTO, THE HEAD OF THE MILITARY POLICE, AND OTHER HIGH-RANKING OFFICERS WHO TRIED, HE SAYS, TO GET HIM TO LIE UNDER OATH FOR THE SAKE OF A POLITICAL PLOT.


GOVAN WHITTLES: What condition were you in on the last day of your torture?

PULE NKOMO: Jo I couldn’t see properly. My eyes were partially closed. I think that the left one Yeah, it was closed, closed, closed. This one it was reddish, full of blood.
I was shaking - all of those things.

GOVAN WHITTLES: How have you been recovering?

PULE NKOMO: I haven't fully recovered. I haven't fully recovered. But the thing of memory loss, my eyes, my hand, my nerves.

GOVAN WHITTLES: What’s wrong with your hand?

PULE NKOMO: Because of the torture, I'll get tremor, most of the time, every day, more than five times a day.

SINCE 1994 SOUTH AFRICA HAS BEEN A CONSTITUTIONAL STATE WITH A BILL OF HUMAN RIGHTS. BUT THE ALLEGATION OF ILLEGAL ACTIVITY BY THE SANDF’S SPECIAL FORCES RAISES MEMORIES OF STATE SPONSORED CRIMINAL OPERATIONS UNDER APARTHEID.

Hennie van Vuuren
Director: Open Secrets
we've seen what kind of abuse the military can get involved in. And I think we're seeing shades and similarities here. It means that we need to look and scrutinise the military, not as the enemy of the people. There are many good military officials out there, but we need to recognise where there is that abuse and it is happening, that we need to stop that.

HENNIE’S INVESTIGATION REVEALS A DARK UNDERWORLD IN THE SANDF. HIS EVIDENCE SUGGESTS THAT AT LEAST SOME OF SOUTH AFRICA’S MOST ELITE SOLDIERS HAVE BEEN DEPLOYED TO UNDERMINE THE CONSTITUTION AND NOT DEFEND IT.

PROMOS

PROMO 1:
A TRAIL OF CLUES….
ACCOUNTS OF ABDUCTION, ASSAULT AND TORTURE BY MEMERS OF THE SANDF…
GOVAN WHITTLES: All of this is an illegal operation?
Hennie van Vuuren
Director: Open Secrets
Every element of this is criminal. There's nothing here. There's nothing here that's normal.



PROMO 2:
A WITNESS IN HIDING….
HIS CHILLING STORY OF KIDNAPPING AND TORTURE, AT THE HANDS OF ELITE SOLDIERS…
GOVAN WHITTLES: What’s wrong with your hand?
PULE NKOMO: Because of the torture, I'll get tremor, most of the time, every day, more than five times a day


PROMO 3:
WHEN AN INVESTIGATION BECOMES A BRUTAL INTERROGATION…
AND THEN A CRIME…
PULE NKOMO:
They, they said no, Major call your guys so that they can squeeze his balls…. they came in, after the Major went to call them and started hitting me.


PROMO 4:
BRAVE SOLDIERS IN THE SANDF BECOME WHISTLEBLOWERS….
BECAUSE THE MILITARY WON’T HEAR THEIR CRIES
Hennie van Vuuren
Director: Open Secrets
Those stories came together to support this, what we've now come to is an understanding of the operation of a torture squad within the South African National Defence Force.

nombuso@carteblanche.co.za 21 May 2024 TX Date: 0000-00-00 Script: Open Secret Special STORY #6482 THIS IS A STORY ABOUT THE BAD AND THE BRAVE… AND HOW AN INVESTIGATOR ON A DARK JOURNEY EXPOSES SHOCKING SECRETS AT THE HEART OF THE SOUTH AFRICAN NATIONAL DEFENCE FORCE… IT’S A STORY THAT STARTS ON THE CAPE COAST, AND TAKES HIM FROM SIMONSTOWN IN THE WESTERN CAPE TO PHALABORWA IN THE NORTH AND THEN TO A MILITARY BASE IN PRETORIA. WHILE STILL UNRESOLVED, THE INVESTIGATION EXPOSES A GROUPING OF ELITE SOLDIERS AND SANDF OFFICIALS WHO APPEAR TO OPERATE ABOVE THE LAW, ENGAGING IN ILLEGAL CAMPAIGNS INVOLVING TORTURE, POLITICS, SPYCRAFT, AND EVEN MURDER. AND THE FIRST CLUE CAME WITH THE ARRIVAL OF A MYSTERIOUS VESSEL AT THE SIMONSTOWN NAVAL BASE ON THE NIGHT OF THE 6TH OF DECEMBER 2022 THE INVESTIGATOR, HENNIE VAN VUUREN, IS AN ANTI-CORRUPTION ACTIVIST AND RESEARCHER ROLLED INTO ONE, WITH EXPERIENCE IN DOCUMENTING THE MOVEMENT OF WEAPONS. Hennie van Vuuren Director: Open Secrets We work like investigative journalists. But we're slightly different. We investigate economic crime, where there's a link to human rights abuse, we investigate, we publish those findings. SO THE LONG-LENS EVIDENCE OF CARGO BEING LOADED OFF AND POSSIBLY ON TO THIS VESSEL, A US-SANCTIONED RUSSIAN CARGO SHIP CALLED THE LADY R, WAS OF GREAT INTEREST TO HENNIE. IT’S ARRIVAL HAD PUT LOCAL SHIPSPOTTERS ON HIGH ALERT, IN THE ABSENCE OF OFFICIAL INFORMATION, PUBLIC SPECULATION AS TO WHY THE LADY R HAD DROPPED ANCHOR GREW TO FEVER PITCH. IMAGES WERE CIRCULATED SHOWING VEHICLES STANDING BY. Hennie van Vuuren Director: Open Secrets … we were able, through some sources, to obtain a copy of a photograph. … But this time, the number plates were clear. And with that number plates, we were then able to start searching where else might this vehicle have appeared. AND BINGO - THREE WEEKS LATER, ONE OF THE SAME CARS WITH AN IDENTICAL NUMBER PLATE WAS CAPTURED BY CCTV CAMERAS IN ANOTHER PROVINCE. Hennie van Vuuren Director: Open Secrets So it's extraordinary that we find the same vehicle, white Mercedes Benz , we were able to establish through photographs that we obtained … that it's registered against a front company, if you'd like a shell company, that front companies directors are all members of a Special Forces unit in Phaloborwa. PETERS COMMUNICATION TRUST IS THE UNLIKELY NAME OF THIS COMPANY, WHICH IS REGISTERED TO THE SANDF’S SPECIAL FORCES, AN ELITE BRIGADE OF HIGHLY TRAINED COMBATANTS, COLLOQUIALLY KNOW AS THE RECCES. IN WHAT SEEMED TO BE AN UNCANNY COINCIDENCE, ONE OF THEIR VEHICLES WAS DOCUMENTED IN GAUTENG. Hennie van Vuuren Director: Open Secrets And what we then found out is that the same vehicle … was on the scene of the abduction of a suspected Islamic State member in the Mall of Africa, only three weeks later on the 29th of December. HENNIE’S STORY NOW LURCHES IN AN UNEXPECTED DIRECTION – BUT BIZARRELY THIS UNEXPLAINED KIDNAPPING PROVIDES CLUES TO TRUTHS THAT UNTIL NOW HAVE BEEN LURKING IN THE SHADOWS. GOVAN WHITTLES PIECE TO CAM: This is one of the busiest malls in Gauteng, people come here from all over to do their shopping and in December 2022 an Ethiopian man and his bodyguard disappeared into thin air, one moment he was paying for his parking ticket - and the next moment he was gone. PANICKING, THE FAMILY OF THE MISSING MAN, ABDELLA ABADIGA, GOT HOLD OF CCTV FOOTAGE AND TRACKED HIS MOVEMENTS, TO SEE WHO WAS ON HIS TAIL. AND HIRED A LAWYER, YUSUF CASSIM. Yusuf Cassim Lawyer for family of Abdella Abadiga Lat time our client was seen, was at the pay station, and directly behind him few seconds later, was the actual member of Special Forces who paid for three tickets of their vehicles at the same time. We believe he was then followed to his vehicle, they were those vehicles waiting in the parking lot. And that's where he was abducted from. THE SANDF ADMITTED THAT SPECIAL FORCES WERE AT THE MALL OF AFRICA ON THAT DAY UNDER THE COMMAND OF A MAJOR PINNY SUNNYBOOI WAMBI WHO PAID FOR THE PARKING TICKETS. BUT THE SANDF DENIED KIDNAPPING ABDELLA ABADIGA AND HIS BODYGUARD. Yusuf Cassim Lawyer for family of Abdella Abadiga They claim that they were there on a training exercise …. So you have a training exercise being conducted in a public space in a mall without anyone's knowledge. Now, that to us is totally unbelievable. WE KNOW VERY LITTLE ABOUT THIS ETHIOPIAN BUSINESSMAN, SAVE THAT HE WAS LISTED ON A UNITED STATES SANCTIONS LIST AS A FINANCIER FOR THE ISLAMIC TERRORIST GROUP, ISIS. YUSUF CASSIM MANAGED TO GET THE POLICE TO INVESTIGATE IN WHAT LOOKS TO HIM SUSPICIOUSLY LIKE A STATE SANCTIONED ABDUCTION, Yusuf Cassim Lawyer for family of Abdella Abadiga This has the making of a rendition. I mean, this reminds one of apartheid style tactics, you know, where you simply kidnap an individual and that's it. That's the last time you hear or see of them. BUT THE ABADIGA INVESTIGATION EXPERIENCED SETBACKS. FIRST, WHEN THE ELITE INVESTIGATIVE UNIT, THE HAWKS, SOUGHT THE CELLPHONE RECORDS OF THE SPECIAL FORCES MEMBERS PHOTOGRAPHED IN THE MALL OF AFRICA, THEY MET WITH RESISTANCE IN COURT FROM THE SANDF. AND THEN ON THE 6TH OF AUGUST THE INVESTIGATOR ON THE CASE, LIEUTENANT COLONEL FRANS MATHIPA, WAS ASSASINATED. Hennie van Vuuren Director: Open Secrets He was driving along the highway, north of Pretoria close to Hammandskraal. He was booked out that night to investigate specifically the role of Special Forces in the abduction of these of these individuals in the Mall of Africa. And he was shot from what we understand twice in the heads with while driving his vehicle.… IT WAS A SOPHISTICATED HIT - WHICH IN ITSELF WAS A CLUE AS TO WHO MAY HAVE PULLED THE TRIGGER GOVAN WHITTLES PIECE TO CAM Shooting someone from a moving vehicle is incredibly difficult. Hitting them twice in the head means you are an elite level marksman. That should tell you who we are dealing with. Yusuf Cassim Lawyer for family of Abdella Abadiga We are dealing with dangerous individuals who can do anything, it seems as they please, you know, they they seem to be above the law. BACK AT OPEN SECRETS, HENNIE SENSED THERE WAS WORSE TO COME. Hennie van Vuuren Director: Open Secrets At that stage we started to identify a pattern of abuse and criminality. We believe according to eyewitnesses and sources, that involves senior generals, it’s a pattern of abuse and human rights violations, of torture, and murder that involves members of Special Forces. IT WAS LIKE A RUSSIAN DOLL. IN THE LADY R COVER-UP THERE WAS A LINK TO A MYSTERIOUS ABDUCTION…. THEN CAME THE ASSASSINATION OF THE HAWKS INVESTIGATOR AND THE NEXT REVELATION TOOK HENNIE BACK IN TIME – TO A MILITARY BASE IN LYTTELTON, PRETORIA FROM WHERE ON THE 23RD OF DECEMBER 2019, 18 R4 ASSAULT RIFLES HAD BEEN STOLEN. THIS THEFT EMBARRASSED THE SANDF PUBLICALLY. AND BEHIND THE SCENES, ACCORDING TO HENNIE’S SOURCES, THE MILITARY’S SPECIAL FORCES GOT TO WORK TO RETRIEVE THE STOLEN WEAPONS AND BRING THE CULPRITS IN. Hennie van Vuuren Director: Open Secrets When we were looking at the role of special forces…. we had various whistle-blowers who approached Open Secrets. And those whistle-blowers there are a number of them, many of them work within the state, some of them have been in state security forces previously. But they had different stories to tell and those stories came together to support this, what we've now come to is an understanding of the operation of a torture squad within the South African National Defence Force. AS THE STORY OF THE WEAPONS HUNT UNFOLDS, HENNIE IS GIVEN AN EYE-WITNESS ACCOUNT OF ANOTHER ALLEGED ABDUCTION, INVOLVING THE SAME SPECIAL FORCES OPERATIVE MAJOR PINNY SUNNYBOOI WAMBI, AROUND SIX WEEKS AFTER THE THEFT OF THE RIFLES. Hennie van Vuuren Director: Open Secrets They have Defence Force Intelligence officials, who according to our sources are guiding them to find someone's cell phone. So again, there is illegal surveillance that's taking place, you have this convoy of vehicles that's making its way along parts of the East Rand. ACCORDING TO A WHISTLEBLOWER, THEY ABDUCT A MAN KNOWN ONLY AS SPHAMANDLA FROM A FAST FOOD RESTAURANT IN KEMPTON PARK. THERE THEY ALLEGEDLY FORCE HIM INTO THEIR VEHICLES. GOVAN WHITTLES PIECE TO CAM It’s hard to imagine the military rolling in here to abduct someone. This is a family friendly space – it’s meant to be a safe zone in the Kempton Park CBD. IT’S ALLEGED THAT THE SPECIAL FORCES TAKE SPHAMANDLA BACK TO THE MILITARY POLICE BAR WHERE THEY TORTURE HIM TO DEATH THAT SAME NIGHT. GOVAN WHITTLES: … all of this is an illegal operation? Hennie van Vuuren Director: Open Secrets Every element of this is criminal. There's nothing here. There's nothing here that's normal. Everything is abnormal. It's anti constitutional. HENNIE WAS THEN APPROACHED BY A FORMER SECURITY OPERATIVE WHO HAD A FEW WEEKS LATER, BEEN LURED TO PRETORIA UNDER THE PRETEXT OF IDENTIFYING A CULPRIT, IN THIS SAME THEFT OF MILITARY WEAPONS. NOW IN HIDING, PULE NKOMO WAS PREPARED TO TALK TO US TOO. HE SAID WE COULD USE HIS NAME, BUT NOT SHOW HIS FACE FOR FEAR OF BEING FOUND. HE ALLEGES HE WAS SUMMONED BY AN SANDF OFFICER WHO IS NOW THE CHIEF OF THE ARMY, GENERAL LAWRENCE MBATHA HIMSELF. Pule Nkomo Victim of Torture General Mbatha called me and said you, Pule, here. We need you to assistance in profiling a person is a former operative also in the security structure. They need to identify him…and they said that he was involved in the Military base robbery. I was a bit scared. I was a bit scared. When Pule arrived in Pretoria, he parked his car across the road and told them he had arrived by bus at the Bosman Station. They told him to wait at that hotel. They told him a little later to go to a nearby shop and walk around for twenty minutes, he thinks that is when they were scoping him out to see if he came alone. Then finally they made contact. FROM THE VICTORIA HOTEL, PULE SAYS HE WAS DRIVEN IN A CONVOY OF CARS TO THE MILITARY BASE THABA TSHWANE THEN TAKEN TO AN OFFICE BY A FEMALE MAJOR. Pule Nkomo Victim of Torture She left me there and said I must sit there, they took my phone, my tablet and the bags, left with them. PULE CLAIMS MBATHA AND OTHER SENIOR MILITARY OFFICIALS THEN ASKED HIM TO MAKE A FALSE STATEMENT TO THE POLICE. THEY WANTED HIM TO IMPLICATE A SENIOR POLITICIAN, WHOSE NAME WE KNOW, IN THE RIFLE ROBBERY, A SERIOUS CRIME. AND ALARMED, PULE DECLINED THE DIRTY TRICKS MISSION AND ASKED TO GO HOME. GOVAN WHITTLES: Did they say anything after you said no? PULE NKOMO: They, they said no, Major call your guys so that they can squeeze his balls…. they came in, after the Major went to call them and started hitting me, in the presence of the General, Colonel, Brigadier, everyone was there. GOVAN WHITTLES: So you passed out? PULE NKOMO: I passed out. When I wake up, I was in hospital. GOVAN WHITTLES: Which hospital? PULE NKOMO: Kalafong. AS HIS MEDICAL RECORDS TESTIFY, PULE AWOKE DIZZY AND BATTERED. BUT HE ALLEGES THEY WERE NOT FINISHED WITH HIM: CLAIMING THAT HE WAS A HIGH-LEVEL SUSPECT, THEY TOOK HIM BACK TO THABA TSHWANE, AND TRIED AGAIN TO CO-ERCE HIM TO TAKE THE JOB. PULE NKOMO: I still went and said no. Then that’s when the intense torture happened. The biggest torture, being beaten, being kicked. GOVAN WHITTLES: Just try to describe it for me. PULE NKOMO:. I was tubed – GOVAN WHITTLES: What’s that? PULE NKOMO: Like they pour too much water on you so that they can - like you drown. They stopped, give you a few minutes, a minute or less, they put a big tube over your face, beat you on top of that tube, kick you everything and came a time when I said to them okay I'll need time to, to think. GOVAN WHITTLES: Who was doing this to you? PULE NKOMO: The guys in balaclavas PULE TOLD US THE MEN IN BALACLAVAS HELD HIM FOR FIVE DAYS. ON THE LAST DAY, AN OFFICIAL FROM A DIFFERENT SECURITY AGENCY ARRIVED AT THE BASE AND FACILITATED HIS RELEASE, GIVING THE BROKEN MAN A BUS TICKET AND SOME CASH FOR THE ROAD HOME. GOVAN WHITTLES PIECE TO CAMERA: The SANDF is notoriously tight-lipped about its secrets, but in this instance keeping allegations of criminality under wraps is proving difficult for its Top Brass. That’s partly because victims and witnesses are coming forward to seek justice. AFTER A BUILD UP OF COMPLAINTS, THE SANDF SET UP A BOARD OF INQUIRY WHICH HAS TAKEN EVIDENCE ON ALLEGATIONS OF SANDF CRIMES THAT TOOK PLACE BETWEEN 2017 AND 2022 – CORRUPTION, COLLUSION, ASSAULT AND TORTURE. BUT THE CHIEF OF THE SANDF HAS FAILED TO ACT ON THIS REPORT. ACCORDING TO SOURCES IT MAY MAKE ADVERSE FINDINGS AGAINST THE CHIEF OF THE MILITARY POLICE REAR ADMIRAL MAKGODI MAPHOTO. SO IN NOVEMBER, THE SANDF’S MOST SENIOR MILITARY POLICEMAN, CHIEF WARRANT OFFICER RAPHAEL NDAWO, SIDE STEPPED HIS OWN EMPLOYER AND REACHED OUT TO THE HEAD OF AFRIFORUM’S PRIVATE PROSECUTION UNIT, GERRIE NEL. Gerrie Nel Afriforum Private Prosecutor he exhausted all internal processes. And he then said, that's, that's enough. You know, he's a brave man. He's got no tolerance for corruption. And he said, something must happen. And I agree with him. NEL HAS WRITTEN A LETTER URGING THE CHIEF OF THE DEFENCE FORCE TO ACT ON THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE INQUIRY. IT IS UNDERSTOOD THAT THERE ARE AT LEAST TWENTY BOXES OF EVIDENCE. Gerrie Nel Afriforum Private Prosecutor They were looking at corruption, corruption with the PPE purchases…procurement fraud, the fact that certain investigations were not proceeded with because people were sheltered from prosecution, and then disturbingly, also that people were tortured, and that people lost their lives during investigation. So that was disturbing. HENNIE HAS HIS OWN GROWING DOSSIER DETAILING ALLEGATIONS OF SANDF CRIMINALITY. PULE CAN IDENTIFY INDIVIDUALS WHO HE ALLEGES WERE PRESENT DURING HIS TORTURE ORDEAL. MAJOR DORRIS NTSHENZHWE, REAR ADMIRAL MAPHOTO, THE HEAD OF THE MILITARY POLICE, AND OTHER HIGH-RANKING OFFICERS WHO TRIED, HE SAYS, TO GET HIM TO LIE UNDER OATH FOR THE SAKE OF A POLITICAL PLOT. GOVAN WHITTLES: What condition were you in on the last day of your torture? PULE NKOMO: Jo I couldn’t see properly. My eyes were partially closed. I think that the left one Yeah, it was closed, closed, closed. This one it was reddish, full of blood. I was shaking - all of those things. GOVAN WHITTLES: How have you been recovering? PULE NKOMO: I haven't fully recovered. I haven't fully recovered. But the thing of memory loss, my eyes, my hand, my nerves. GOVAN WHITTLES: What’s wrong with your hand? PULE NKOMO: Because of the torture, I'll get tremor, most of the time, every day, more than five times a day. SINCE 1994 SOUTH AFRICA HAS BEEN A CONSTITUTIONAL STATE WITH A BILL OF HUMAN RIGHTS. BUT THE ALLEGATION OF ILLEGAL ACTIVITY BY THE SANDF’S SPECIAL FORCES RAISES MEMORIES OF STATE SPONSORED CRIMINAL OPERATIONS UNDER APARTHEID. Hennie van Vuuren Director: Open Secrets we've seen what kind of abuse the military can get involved in. And I think we're seeing shades and similarities here. It means that we need to look and scrutinise the military, not as the enemy of the people. There are many good military officials out there, but we need to recognise where there is that abuse and it is happening, that we need to stop that. HENNIE’S INVESTIGATION REVEALS A DARK UNDERWORLD IN THE SANDF. HIS EVIDENCE SUGGESTS THAT AT LEAST SOME OF SOUTH AFRICA’S MOST ELITE SOLDIERS HAVE BEEN DEPLOYED TO UNDERMINE THE CONSTITUTION AND NOT DEFEND IT. PROMOS PROMO 1: A TRAIL OF CLUES….
